comments:
This commentary on the Sañcayagāthā (ID:3693) may correspond to the work listed by A khu ching shes rab rgya mtsho in his Tho yig ([5RXEUKD9]: 529, No. 11503: [ar byang chub ye shes kyi] mdo sdud pa).
The explanation of the words of the base text is preceded by an introduction that includes an outline of Prajñāpāramitā literature. The author refers to other commentaries on the text (one referred to as “new commentary”), and to the interpretation of “lo tsa ba” (rNgog Blo ldan
shes rab) and “’bum” (i.e., ’Bum phrag gsum pa, brTan skyong/Sthirapāla), and claims to have followed mainly the commentary of Buddhaśrījñāna.

The introductory verse echoes that of the Shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba'i 'grel pa rnaM par 'byed pa (ID:4455) by the same author.

Two instances of the work are extant - (ID:4456) and (ID:5892) - with different, but partially overlapping, annotations.
